banner.title: THE MOUNTED MOVEMENT CHARGE - the R123 feeder goes live, the warhorse kinds ride
banner.provenance: The R776 site and the R777 stable left the mount bought but afoot in play: mountKind is saved and printed, yet nobody rides. This round charges the R123 feeder: a living member on a warhorse kind (2-4, the sdd ladder - Curtiss's call; the riding horse and pony stay walkers, the draft is a cart animal) moves at his mount's dm miles/day rate, every other member walks at his burden class, the henchman walks, and the company rides at the slowest member's pace. The kind mapping reads the saddle ladder consts through warhorseDmKind (game/party.h, the saddle include per the R400 lesson), the site is overlandMilesPerDay (game/state_overland.cpp, flipped from companyFootMilesPerDay to companyRiderMilesPerDay), and both TUs ride the preflight battery build, so every line is compile-gated. The first cut died at the Termux preflight: the party.h saddle include opened a second inclusion path in state_core, state_town and regtest (36 redefinitions), so the repair carries the classic #ifndef include guard on the saddle header (the wisdom.h house style; pragma once struck by Curtiss - a Windows-ism) - rverify is Python-only and cannot see the C++ double-include class
banner.sentinel: Zero new book pages: the rates ride the already-pinned R123 dm/outdoormove.h mounted rows
